title: Aviation Technology Consulting for Airports
intro: Airports operate complex technology environments that must serve multiple airlines, ground handlers and passengers simultaneously. AeroExpert advises airports on passenger processing technology, common-use systems, baggage technology, flight information displays, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity and digital transformation — with deep understanding of the multi-stakeholder airport environment.

services.title: Passenger Processing Systems
services.desc: CUTE, CUSS, self-service kiosks and check-in system strategy, selection and implementation.

services.title: Baggage Technology
services.desc: Baggage management, reconciliation, RFID tracking and mishandling reduction.

services.title: IT Infrastructure & Cloud
services.desc: Airport IT infrastructure modernisation, cloud migration and high-availability architecture.

services.title: Aviation Cybersecurity
services.desc: Specialist aviation cybersecurity risk assessment, maturity assessment and IT governance for airports.

services.title: Digital Transformation
services.desc: Airport digital maturity assessment, technology roadmap and legacy modernisation.

services.title: Technology Procurement
services.desc: Independent procurement advisory for airport technology systems.

closing: To discuss your airport's technology requirements, contact us.
